content:
Last weekend, Apple TV made several announcements at San Diego Comic-Con, including a surprise about the premiere date of the fourth season of "Silo."

The fourth season of "Silo" will debut in the summer of 2027 and will serve as its final season.

The third season of "Silo" is currently airing (available here), with new episodes releasing weekly until September 4.

However, at San Diego Comic-Con last weekend, in addition to revealing updates on other sci-fi series, Apple also brought a surprise for fans of "Silo."

The fourth season of "Silo" will return next summer, bringing the entire series to a close.

Below is the announcement post from Apple TV's X account:

In the streaming era, it's common for series to have multi-year gaps between seasons, and this is especially true for high-budget sci-fi productions like "Silo."

However, Apple has been working to accelerate the return of some of its series, giving them the green light early. In the case of "Silo," the third and fourth seasons were launched simultaneously and filmed back-to-back.

There are still six weeks left in the current run of "Silo." However, once the third season wraps up, the wait for the fourth season won't be too long.

What do you think of the third season of "Silo"? Feel free to let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, and can also be subscribed to via the Apple One bundle.
